blocks.text: LEGAZPI CITY — The Daraga Community College in Albay has inaugurated its solar-powered building on Wednesday (October 21), providing a more environment-friendly learning facility for its more than 6,000 students. Located in Barangay Salvacion in the town of Daraga, the four-story building is equipped with solar panels capable of generating 96 kilowatts of electricity, or 96,000 watts, helping meet the college’s power needs and minimize interruptions to classes, municipal engineer Fiel Montallano said.
